# iliad-102 (16.306–393) — review

Verified against `source/iliad-monro-allen1920.json` and the published parts in the repository root.

Counts: 0 high, 12 medium, 22 low = 34 field edits (in 27 units); 14 findings refused.

## Checked and left (verified true)

- 2.494 Peneleos among the Boeotian leaders; 2.627–628 Meges Phyleides; 5.72, 13.692 (same patronymic); 16.149 Xanthus and Balius; 2.527–528 Oileus’ Ajax "smaller"; 4.469, 5.46, 5.83, 6.179, 7.26, 7.440, 4.456, 15.328 all say what the notes say.
- Paragraph marks at 306, 351, 358, 364 = `p`; no other unit has `p`. `ln` correct for every unit; line count of `l` equals that of `t` in every unit; typographic ’ throughout, no straight quotes.
- Speeches: none in 306–393 (similes and narration only). Previous part (iliad-101) ends in narration, no speech runs in. No quotation marks or `mark` needed.
- Scansion: packet flags none; no note adds an irregularity claim. The Τρωϊκόν syllable count (368) was the only prosody statement and is fixed.
- Pass 2 `l` ↔ `i` agreement in sense and force found no further problem (checked in particular 313, 321, 328–329, 350, 362, 366, 382–383).

## Findings considered and refused

1. φόβος "flight" (357, 366, 373): the table fixes "flight" for φόβος in battle (5.252, 5.272, 12.39, 12.432); "terror" is used only for φόβον Ἄρηος (2.767) and the departure at 11.402. "flight" is right here. Kept.
2. ἐπικάρ (392): l "head first" / i "plunging" with "sense not certain" matches the Odyssey’s treatment of ἐπικάρσιος (a guess from κάρ-). Kept.
3. καυλός (338–339): l "stem", i "near the hilt" departs from the table’s "socket" (13.608, spear). Refused to force "socket" onto a sword; the departure is listed in new-renderings.md and the note now hedges.
4. "mares" (393): ἵπποι Τρῳαί with feminine adjective and θέουσαι; "mares" is the right rendering and the note says why. Kept.
5. φάλον "ridge", ἀμαιμακέτην "huge", ἑτεραλκέα, ἐρίηρας, ὄπιν: all follow shipped rows and carry "not certain/known" in the notes. Kept.
6. ἀέλλη (374) note reading it as the dust: stated as the note’s reading, not as Greek; kept.
7. 311 l "in the chest, laid bare": ambiguous English but not wrong for either construction; kept.
8. 330 l "having rushed at Cleobulus": kept (Greek word order); note now gives the construction.
9. 366 i "there arose from them a cry and flight": clumsy but true to τῶν ἐκ νηῶν; kept.
10. 362 note "the day is going to the Achaeans": sense is disputed in the Odyssey, but here the context (Hector sees the Danaans winning) fixes it; kept.
11. 313 i "thrusting" for ὀρεξάμενος: table 4.307/5.851 use "thrust"; kept.
12. 387 "pass crooked judgments" for σκολιὰς κρίνωσι θέμιστας: i-level paraphrase with the literal in `l`; kept.
13. 351 i "were the leaders of the Danaans": fine.
14. "about" text ("Achilles’ deathless horses leap the ditch in pursuit of Hector", Patroclus "driving men"): loose but true to 380–383, 372–379; kept.

## Pass 2 — gloss.json and new-renderings.md

Checked every one of the 106 new entries and all 19 `__broaden__` entries against the lines (case, tense, mood, voice, meaning, format). Format gate (`check_gloss.py`): no missing or extra keys, all under 230 characters, no line numbers, no straight quotes, no "here", every broaden is the old entry whole + " · " + new reading. Every added reading was confirmed to occur in 16.306–393.

Counts: 0 high, 7 medium, 12 low = 19 changes (13 new-entry edits, 4 added or rewritten broadens, 2 notes in `units.json`), plus 14 changes to `new-renderings.md` (3 medium, 11 low, listed separately below).

### new-renderings.md (now matches `l`/`i` in units.json)

Rows brought into line (stale after pass 1 or inexact): δούπησεν (`l`/`i` "fell with a thud"), ἐξεπέρησε (Odyssey wording in both layers; row retitled with the whole phrase), κατὰ μοῖραν (`l` "according to what is fitting"; first-draft wording moved to the avoided column), ζωὸν ἕλε ("took him alive"), παρηέρθη (`i` "hung over to one side"), νέρθεν (`i` "beneath the brain"), ἔγχεσι (`i` "with their spears"), διαρπάζουσιν (`l` "tear them apart"), φόβοιο μνήσαντο (`l` order), ἰαχή τε φόβος τε (adds the 373 wording), βλαφθέντα (`i` "who was hindered"), λαβρότατον (records the adjective/adverb split), καυλός (hedge as in the note), ἄξαντ’ (dual). No row exists for διὰ πρὸ … ἔλασσε: its English is the published iliad-081 wording, so it is not a new rendering and needs none. All other rows checked against `l`/`i`: they agree.

### Considered and left

- ἄχρις "right up to the end, utterly" against `l` "right through": same sense; left.
- ἀέκοντας "agreeing with ἵππους/ἑταίρους": parse (masc. acc. pl.) true; it agrees with οὓς (the Trojan host, sense construction); left.
- φόβος entry headed by the personified Φόβος: the second reading ("flight, fear, not personified") covers 366; left.
- ἔφθη "strong aorist" for the root aorist: imprecise, not wrong; left.
